# pve_appliances (Data Source)

Lists the appliance templates (container templates and virtual appliance images) available on a node as reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/aplinfo`. Templates are downloaded to a storage via `POST /nodes/{node}/aplinfo`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_appliances" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "appliance_templates" {
  value = [for a in data.pve_appliances.pve1.appliances : a.template]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose appliance list is read.

### Read-Only

- `appliances` (Attributes List) Appliance templates available on the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appliances))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source (the node name).

<a id="nestedatt--appliances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appliances`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) Target architecture of the template, e.g. `amd64`.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the appliance.
- `info` (String) URL with more information about the appliance.
- `infrastructure` (String) Infrastructure repository the template belongs to, e.g. `pve`.
- `manage_url` (String) Management URL to open after deployment (`<ip>` is replaced at runtime).
- `os` (String) Operating system identifier of the appliance, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`.
- `package` (String) Package name of the appliance.
- `section` (String) Category of the appliance, e.g. `system` or `mail`.
- `sha512sum` (String) SHA-512 checksum of the template archive.
- `source` (String) Source the template was retrieved from.
- `template` (String) File name of the template archive, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04-standard_24.04-2_amd64.tar.zst`.
- `version` (String) Version of the appliance package.
